title: Lesson 15: Special Division
learningGoals: Perform fast division near base numbers.
Adapt method for above-base and below-base divisors.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Open Special Division with one fast mental-math hook and connect it to prior knowledge.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Recall what you already know about Division by 9.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Explain the rule behind Division by 9 in simple language.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Repeat the rule for Division by 8 and Similar Bases in your own words.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Model Division by 8 and Similar Bases step by step on the board.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Watch the example and say the next step before it is revealed.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Guide the learner through Division by 8 and Similar Bases with prompt-based support.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Solve a scaffolded example on Divisor Below Base Number.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Shift to independent practice on Division by 99 and 98 across difficulty levels.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Answer independent questions on Divisor Above Base Number.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Diagnose errors and reteach the exact step that broke down.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Explain the mistake and correct it.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Ask the learner to explain the shortcut before advancing.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Summarize the method for Division by 8 and Similar Bases.
